images.filename: ACWA Leadership Meets With Blue Grass Community Stakeholders (5407489941).jpg
images.caption: Madison County Judge-Executive Kent Clark, right, listens to program updates from Assembled Chemical Weapons Alternatives (ACWA) Acting Program Manager Conrad Whyne during a meeting between ACWA leadership and Blue Grass community stakeholders. Program leaders met with several members of the community and local elected officials to discuss the status of the chemical demilitarization project in Kentucky.

images.caption:
Mr. Kingston Reif, Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Threat Reduction and Arms Control (DASD(TRAC)), visited Richmond, Kentucky, June 7 to attend a media day regarding the impending completion of the destruction of the chemical weapons stored at the Blue Grass Army Depot (BGAD). Six local and area media outlets attended the event.
The media day presenters follow:
Mr. Kingston Reif, DASD(TRAC)
Mr. Michael Abaie, program executive officer, Assembled Chemical Weapons Alternatives
Dr. Candace Coyle, site project manager, Blue Grass Chemical Agent-Destruction Pilot Plant
Mr. Ron Hink, project manager, Bechtel Parsons Blue Grass
Col. Brett Ayvazian, commander, BGAD 
Lt. Col. Tyler McKee, commander, Blue Grass Chemical Activity
Judge Executive Reagan Taylor, Madison County

Mr. Craig Williams, co-chair, Kentucky Chemical Demilitarization Citizens’ Advisory Commission and Chemical Destruction Community Advisory Board
